parts.name: Central Connector Clearance Notch (Panel & Wire)
parts.description: Corner notch machined into a panel so it clears the central connector (pg. 4-20) when the panel mounts inside a 15 series T-slot. 7320 is the service's Panel & Wire Part No.; the Aluminum Part No. is 7204.
features: Used to clear central connector (pg. 4-20) when a panel mounts inside T-slot
Works with mesh, plastic panels, and aluminum up to .250” (6.35mm) thick
When ordering, specify a vertical or horizontal orientation
parts.dimension_notes: A = horizontal width of the corner notch, B = vertical height of the corner notch; notch inside corner radius R .125” (3.18mm)
parts.notes: Reference page 11-31. Specify vertical or horizontal orientation and the panel corner when ordering. Ordering example printed on the page: 2609 (1) @ (AD) 23.000” x (AB) 28.000” w/7320 Vertical on Corner B. Metric equivalents 30-, 40-, 45-7320/7204 not extracted.

page_notes.807: 11-33 Inside Corner Connector Clearance Notch: single row 7161/7219 badged 15 and 40, extracted as two services.

page_notes.809: 11-35 Hidden Corner Connector Clearance Notch: 15 rows 7522 (inside to inside) and 7523 (inside to outside) extracted; 10 series 7422/7423 and metric 25-/30-/40-/45- rows skipped.
page_notes.811: 11-37 Pipe Mount Clearance Notch: 15 rows 7605/7606 (corner) and 7607/7608 (tee) extracted; metric 65- rows skipped.
page_notes.812: 11-38 Grabber Door Catch Panel Milling 7313 (F) and Locking Grabber Handle Panel Milling 7510 (F) extracted; metric 65-7313 and 65-7510 skipped.
page_notes.813: 11-39 Flush Handle Plastic Panel Milling 7520 and 7521 (F) extracted; metric 65-7520 and 65-7521 skipped.

corrected: 7313: description 'to provide clearance for and mount the Grabber™ door catch' -> 'to provide clearance for the Grabber™ door catch' (page only states clearance)
7522: dimension_notes (missing) -> added from Inside to Inside drawing (A and B each dimensioned horizontally and vertically)
7161: dimension_notes C 'height of the angled lower portion' -> 'height from the start of the angled cut to the panel edge'
7219: dimension_notes C 'height of the angled lower portion' -> 'height from the start of the angled cut to the panel edge'
remaining_doubts: Each table row with both a Panel & Wire Part No. and an Aluminum Part No. (pages 11-31 to 11-34, 11-37) is output as two machining_service parts sharing the same specs; downstream may prefer merging them.
Page 11-34 ordering example cites 7605 (the Pipe Mount notch) rather than 7321/7322; recorded verbatim in notes as printed, likely a catalog typo.
7161/7219 row is badged 15 and 40 (metric); kept as series ["15"] with the 40 badge noted.
